parse.title: Karamja Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Karamja" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
| 1. Pick 5 [[banana]]s from the [[Banana plantation|plantation]] located east of the [[Karamja Volcano|volcano]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
| 2. Use the [[Ropeswing_(Brimhaven)|rope swing]] to travel to the [[Moss Giant Island]] north-west of [[Karamja]].
| 
*{{SCP|Agility|10|link=yes}}
|-
| 3. Mine some [[gold ore|gold]] from the rocks on the [[North Brimhaven mine|north-west peninsula]] of [[Karamja]].
| 
*{{SCP|Mining|40|link=yes}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
| 4. Travel to [[Port Sarim]] via the dock, east of [[Musa Point]].
|
*30 [[coins]] or an activated [[Ring of charos (a)|ring of charos]]
''This can also be completed by travelling to Port Sarim from [[The Pandemonium]] via [[Seaman Morris]].''
|-
| 5. Travel to [[Ardougne]] via the port near [[Brimhaven]].
| 
*30 [[coins]] or an activated [[Ring of charos (a)|ring of charos]]
|-
| 6. Explore [[Cairn Isle|Cairn Island]] to the west of [[Karamja]].
| 
*{{SCP|Agility|15|link=yes}}
|-
| 7. Use the [[Fishing spots]] north of the [[banana plantation]].
''Note: Fishing at any of the [[fishing spots]] there will count for this task.
|
*[[Harpoon]] (or [[Barbarian_Training#Barbarian_Fishing|bare-handed fishing]]), [[lobster pot]], [[small fishing net]], or a [[fishing rod]] with [[Fishing bait|bait]], depending on the spot you fish at
|-
| 8. Collect 5 [[seaweed]] from anywhere on [[Karamja]].
''Note: You can just drop and pick up the same [[seaweed]] five times. ''
|
*[[Seaweed]] (can be found near [[Jiminua's Jungle Store.|Jiminua's Jungle Store]])
|-
| 9. Attempt the [[TzHaar Fight Pit]]s or [[Fight Cave]].
''Note: You can simply enter and leave after the first wave begins. No actual attempt is necessary, but the [[Fight Pits]] will not allow entrance without at least one other player.''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
| 10. Kill a [[jogre]] in the [[Pothole dungeon]].
|
*[[Weaponry]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Karamja gloves 1]]:
**While worn, [[Brimhaven]]—[[Ardougne]] and [[Musa Point]]—[[Port Sarim]] boat trips cost 15 [[coins]] instead of 30 [[coins]]
**While worn, items in [[Karamja gloves#Discounted shops|various shops]] around [[Karamja]] are sold at a discounted rate and bought for more
*[[Antique lamp (Karamja Diary)|Antique lamp]] worth 1,000 experience in any skill of any level (instead of the usual [[Antique lamp (easy)|antique lamp]] for this tier)
